messages:
emily: Working through the new sample-app guide and hit a couple of redwoodctl annoyances while doing local testing. thought i'd surface them here.

ryan: ok what happened?

emily: two things: 1) when I run `redwoodctl local serve --profile sample-app` it picks up the wrong profile if I previously used `sample-App` (case mismatch). 2) while iterating on auth flows the device-code refresh fails intermittently if I restart the local server; a short retry would have avoided halting dev flow.

zara: for (1) we should normalize profile names on lookup (case-insensitive keys) but preserve the original display name. low-risk.

ryan: agree. for (2) is this the keepalive socket reuse issue or something else?

emily: looks like keepalive reuse. repro steps in the sample app repo:```bash
# repro loop
redwoodctl login --auth-method device --profile sample-app &
while true; do
  curl -sS http://localhost:8080/health || true
  sleep 1
  # restart local server (ctrl-c + restart) to flip sockets
done
```
After a restart the refresh poll suddenly 401s or errors with `request canceled`.

zara: that's consistent with connection reuse + closed socket. we've seen similar in port-forward cases. adding a retry with small backoff for refresh polling would help the device flow.

emily: another tiny DX thing: the sample-app onboarding doc tells people to `redwoodctl local serve` but doesn't mention the `--profile` precedence or how to force a config path. newbies keep wondering why their endpoints differ.

ryan: actionable list: 1) make profile lookup case-insensitive, 2) add `--config-path` flag to CLI, 3) add a 3-attempt jittered retry for auth refresh/polling, controlled by env `REDWOODCTL_AUTH_RETRIES`, default 0 in prod and 3 in dev builds, 4) update sample-app onboarding doc with explicit note about profile precedence and `--no-keepalive` env var as a temporary workaround.

emily: sounds good. i'll open a tiny PR to update the sample-app README with the workaround and exact repro.

devx-bot: Suggested issue created draft: "redwoodctl: normalize profile lookup; configurable config path; retry on transient auth refresh failures" (needs assignee).

ci-bot: Issue created: INF-3201 "sample-app DX: profile case-insensitivity + auth refresh retry + onboarding docs" assigned to @ryan.

ryan: i'll take INF-3201. quick plan: implement case-insensitive map for profiles, add `--config-path` parsing, implement a small retry wrapper for the refresh endpoint (idempotent) and wire env var/flag, then docs update.

zara: for tests please add an e2e that simulates server restart during device polling and asserts we recover gracefully with retries.

emily: thanks y'all. i'll validate with the sample-app once CI merges. tagging this thread: `sample-app`, `onboarding`, `redwoodctl`, `auth-retry`.
